verdict.rationale: Mercury's own marketing states it pays unlimited cashback that is automatically deposited into the account, with no manual redemption or points (mercury-docs-8). It specifies 1.5% cashback on credit card spend (mercury-docs-38), which covers both the automatic-earning and no-redemption elements of the story. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that cashback is actually auto-deposited, and in-depth first-party documentation (terms, deposit cadence, exclusions) beyond marketing copy.
